  • Non-Toxic Pest Control and Prevention

Non-Toxic Pest Control and Prevention (DE-UZ 34)

Insect fabrics, mouse traps, rat traps, rodent traps, insect traps, hygiene pests, material pests, noxious rodents
  • Basic Award Criteria
    • Basic Award Criteria (PDF)
    • Application Documents (ZIP)
    • To apply (RAL portal)

Fewer pests combined with better health

Pests – like cockroaches, moths or bugs – in the house need to be removed. A spray will quickly solve the problem. Unfortunately, many customary pest control sprays contain toxic substances and impact the indoor air quality. Traditional pest control textiles or fly strips which work by means of glue or light are a good alternative.
